نبذة

Sasha Beauty Salon, established in 1994, offers a complete "Salon Spa" experience in the UAE. Our skilled team provides a wide range of services including nail extensions, nail art, eyelash extensions, hair treatments and color, facials, waxing, massages, manicures, pedicures, and reflexology. We pride ourselves on enhancing each client's beauty and style with exceptional service and modern trends. Conveniently located in top retail destinations and upmarket residential areas in Dubai, we are dedicated to exceeding your expectations with world-class products and unparalleled customer care. Vis
